div.head: I Atr 1
div.ab: Þæt is, þæt ælc freoman getreowne borh hæbbe, þæt se borh hine to ælcon rihte gehealde, gif he betyhtlad wurðe.
Þæt is, ðæt ælc freoman getreowne borh hæbbe, þæt se borh hine to ælcon rihte gehealde, gyf he betyhtlad wurðe.
Hoc est, ut omnis liber homo habeat credibilem plegium, qui eum ad omne rectum presentet, si fuerit accusatus.
[Be borgum.] [Ld] Þæt is, ðǽt ælc freoman getreowne borh hæbbe, þæt se borh hine to ælcon rihte gehealde, gyf he betyhtlad wurðe.
Namely, that every freeman shall have a trustworthy surety who shall hold him to the performance of every legal duty, if he has been accused.
(Von Bürgen. Ld) Nämlich, dass jeder Freie glaubwürdige Bürgschaft habe, damit der Bürge ihn zu jeder Rechtspflicht festhalte, falls jener angeklagt werden sollte.
(Of sureties. Ld) Namely, that every free man have a trustworthy surety, so that the surety may hold him to every legal obligation, if he should be accused.
